unsupported.title: 当前工作台不支持此生成范围
This generation scope is not supported
unsupported.body: 所选范围包含当前不支持的跨表循环：{tables}。这不是行数或生成器参数错误。具体原因见下方；SQLite 追加仅在循环内每条单列外键已有可用父键时受支持，缺少来源时全选或原样重试无法解除限制。

The selected scope contains an unsupported cross-table cycle: {tables}. This is not a row-count or generator-parameter error. View the specific cause. SQLite append requires existing parent keys on every single-column foreign key in the cycle; selecting all tables or retrying unchanged cannot replace missing sources.
unsupported.partialOrder: 以下仅为可排序的部分，不是完整可执行计划；当前范围的跨表循环生成尚未受工作台支持。
These are only the groups that can be ordered, not a complete executable plan. The workbench does not yet support generation for this scope's cross-table cycle.
unsupported.preview: 当前范围无法生成新样例，已有数据库记录不受影响。
New samples cannot be generated for this scope. Existing database records are unaffected.
unsupported.otherScope: 如果以后改为生成其他范围
If you later choose a different generation scope
unsupported.scope: 拟生成范围（当前无法执行）
execution.existingCycle: 向现有数据追加，不清空表。本次循环引用使用运行开始前已有的父键；新生成的循环表记录不会互相引用。全部所选表在同一事务中追加，任一写入失败会回滚本次新增记录。

Append adds data without clearing tables. Cycle references use parent keys that exist before this run; newly generated cycle rows do not reference one another. All selected tables append in one transaction, and any write failure rolls back the new rows.
execution.resetDialect: 当前工作台不支持 {dialect} 的清空与自增重置；此选项仅适用于 SQLite。
The workbench does not support clearing or identity reset for {dialect}. This option is available only for SQLite.
execution.resetUnneeded: 本次没有 AUTOINCREMENT 历史序列需要重置。普通整数主键在成功清空且由数据库自动分配时从 1 开始；自定义主键规则仍按配置取值。

No AUTOINCREMENT sequence needs resetting in this scope. After successful clearing, ordinary integer primary keys start at 1 when assigned by the database; custom primary-key rules still determine their own values.
execution.resetBlocked: 生成或清空检查未通过，当前不能清空或写入；重置计数不能解除这些限制。
Generation or clearing checks have not passed, so clearing and writing are unavailable. Resetting the counter cannot remove those blockers.
execution.resetAppend: 追加会保留现有记录及自增计数，不能重置。仅在可执行的清空计划中使用此选项。
Append keeps existing records and identity counters. Reset is available only with an executable clearing plan.
execution.resetChecking: 正在核对清空计划，完成前不能更改自增重置。
The clearing plan is being checked. Identity reset is unavailable until it completes.
execution.resetNoPlan: 尚无可用的清空计划，暂不能启用重置；这不表示数据库一定不支持。
No usable clearing plan is available yet. Reset cannot be enabled; this does not by itself mean the database lacks support.
execution.resetNotSupported: 当前服务端计划中没有可重置的 AUTOINCREMENT 表。
The current server plan contains no AUTOINCREMENT table eligible for reset.
clear.guidanceLocation: {status}. Recovery actions are in the guide above.
action.busy: 正在{action}，请稍候。期间可以查看和编辑字段。
{action} is in progress. You can still view and edit fields.
schema.external: 这是其他 schema 的引用来源，仅展示结构。
This reference comes from another schema. Only its structure is shown.
scope.summary: 本次生成 {selected} 张 · 仅引用 {references} 张
dependency.unchecked: Rules and dependencies have not been checked
welcome.title: 从数据库结构开始
Start with your database schema
welcome.help: 先连接一个数据库，读取表、字段和约束，再配置需要生成的数据。
Connect to a database to read its tables, fields and constraints, then configure the data you want to generate.
schema.cached: 当前连接有任务正在运行，暂时显示上次读取的缓存结构。可以查看和编辑配置，任务完成后请重新读取结构。
A task is running on this connection. The last cached schema is shown. You can view and edit the configuration; refresh the schema when the task finishes.
welcome.mismatch: 配置与当前数据库不匹配
welcome.mismatchHelp: 当前数据库连接可用；此链接属于另一数据库。返回可继续当前数据库的配置，未保存的修改仍会保留。
The current connection is available, but this link belongs to another database. Return to continue working with the current database; unsaved changes are preserved.
route.draftMismatch: 此配置属于另一数据库，请先连接对应数据库。
This configuration belongs to another database. Connect to that database first.
route.runMismatch: 运行记录属于另一数据库，请先连接对应数据库后再打开快照。
This run belongs to another database. Connect to that database before opening its snapshot.
dependency.title: 依赖检查
Dependency check
ai.title: AI 配置助手
AI configuration assistant
action.viewPlanHelp: 检查配置并查看写入计划，确认后生成数据
Check the configuration and review the write plan before confirming generation
config.editYamlHelp: 直接编辑完整生成配置；应用后仍需检查和确认写入
Edit the complete generation configuration; validation and write confirmation are still required after applying changes
defaults.title: 全局生成设置
Global generation settings
defaults.scope: 作用于当前配置中的所有表
Applies to all tables in the current configuration
guide.label: 使用引导
Usage guide
page.label: 生成配置工作台
Data generation workbench
defaults.overrides: 字段规则：{fields}{additional}。更换全局引擎会保留字段覆盖。
Field rules: {fields}{additional}. Changing the global engine keeps field overrides.
defaults.mimesisUnavailable: Mimesis {status}，使用此引擎的字段暂不能预览或生成。
Mimesis is {status}. Fields using this engine cannot be previewed or generated yet.
clear.switchedAppend: 已改为追加，保留现有数据；尚未写入数据库。
Switched to append, preserving existing data. Nothing has been written to the database.
guide.editHelp: 在左侧选择生成表，在字段规则中调整取值。修改后可随时切到“预览样例”查看效果。
Select tables on the left and adjust their field rules. Switch to Preview samples whenever you want to check the result.
guide.previewTitle: 查看当前规则生成的样例
View samples from the current rules
guide.previewHelp: 样例不会写入数据库。核对字段内容与业务要求；需要修改时返回“设定规则”。
Samples are not written to the database. Check the field values against your requirements; return to Set rules to make changes.
guide.confirmTitle: Review the target and write mode
guide.confirmHelp: 确认生成数量和已有数据处理方式。清空模式会额外检查未选下游表，只有在确认窗口提交后才写入。
Confirm row counts and how to handle existing data. Clear mode also checks unselected downstream tables. Data is only written after you submit the confirmation dialog.
guide.confirmLabel: 核对生成计划；此处不会直接写入
Review generation plan; this does not write data
guide.rulesLabel: Return to edit rules at any time
guide.previewLabel: 查看样例，不写入数据库
View samples without writing to the database
ai.stale: 配置已变化，请重新分析。
ai.fieldStale: 建议字段已失效，请刷新结构。
The suggested field is no longer available. Refresh the schema.
ai.applied: 已应用 {count} 条 AI 建议。请预览并检查，确认效果后生成数据。
Applied AI suggestions: {count}. Preview and check the results before generating data.
ai.resolving: 正在解析当前配置的字段生成方式…
Resolving field generation modes for the current configuration…
ai.schemaStale: 数据库结构已变化，请刷新后重新打开 AI 助手。
The database schema changed. Refresh it and reopen the AI assistant.
ai.unavailable: AI 扩展{status}，规则建议与分析不可用。请前往插件与版本{action}后返回。
The AI component is {status}, so rule suggestions and analysis are unavailable. Go to Components and versions to {action}, then return.
config.name: 配置名称
Configuration name
schema.refreshHelp: 重新读取表、字段和外键；不生成样例或写入数据
Reread tables, fields and foreign keys; no samples are generated and no data is written
preview.selectedHelp: 预览已勾选的 {count} 张表，不写入数据库

preview.selectedHelp.one: Preview the {count} selected table without writing to the database
preview.selectedHelp.other: Preview the {count} selected tables without writing to the database

count.help: 填写大于 0 的完整整数；工作台最多精确表示 9,007,199,254,740,991。实际生成规模受磁盘、运行时间、唯一值和外键约束影响。
Enter a positive whole number. The workbench can represent up to 9,007,199,254,740,991 exactly. Practical generation size depends on disk space, runtime, unique values and foreign key constraints.
count.changed: 生成数量已改变，请点击“预览数据”重新查看。
Generation count changed. Open Preview data to refresh the samples.
count.label: {table} 生成数量
Generation count for {table}
schema.emptyHeading: 当前数据库还没有可配置的表
This database has no tables to configure yet
schema.emptyHelp: 请先在数据库工具中创建表，再重新读取结构；也可以选择已有表的其他数据库。
Create tables with a database tool, then refresh the schema, or select another database that already has tables.
table.summary: {fields} 个字段 · 已有 {rows} 行
count.title: 生成数量
Generation count
tab.label: 当前表视图
Current table view
preview.afterEdit: 规则调整后，可在当前表的“预览数据”中检查效果。
After adjusting rules, check the results in Preview data for the current table.
preview.readOnly: Preview does not write to the database
rule.autoHelp: 追加数据，由数据库继续分配主键；保留已有 ID
Append data and let the database assign primary keys; existing IDs are preserved
rule.nullHelp: 省略该列，由数据库填入 NULL
Omit this column and let the database insert NULL
rule.coverParent: 优先覆盖父表可用记录
rule.sampleParent: 从父表的可用记录中取值
Take values from available parent records
field.draftHelp: 当前表未勾选，可查看和调整草稿；不会纳入本次生成。
This table is not selected. You can view and edit its draft, but it will not be generated.
field.tableHelp: 字段名查看结构，取值规则调整生成方式
Select a field name to view its structure, or a value rule to edit generation
field.scrollLabel: Field rules for {table}; scroll to view more
field.name: 字段
Field
field.stale: 配置已变化，请重新打开字段规则。
Configuration changed. Reopen the field rule editor.
field.applied: {table}.{column} 的规则已应用，请在“预览数据”中检查效果。
Rule applied for {table}.{column}. Check the result in Preview data.
field.previewHelp: 在预览中调整此字段；返回时保留表、列和滚动位置。应用后样例会标记为待更新，再预览即可核对效果。
Adjust this field in the preview. Returning preserves the table, column and scroll position. Applied changes mark samples as outdated; preview again to check the result.
field.aiPending: 请先应用或取消当前修改，再使用 AI 调整此字段。
Apply or cancel your current changes before using AI to adjust this field.
field.aiHelp: 针对当前字段提出规则建议，审阅后再应用。
Get rule suggestions for this field, then review and apply them.
field.structureHelp: 读取自数据库的结构信息。生成规则不会修改表结构。
Schema information read from the database. Generation rules do not change table structure.
field.checkConstraints: 所属表的 CHECK 约束
field.checkHelp: 这些约束作用于整张表，可能涉及其他字段。
These constraints apply to the entire table and may involve other fields.
schema.externalSource: 外部引用来源，仅展示结构。
External reference source; only its structure is shown.
edge.title: 外键引用
Foreign key reference
edge.help: 箭头从父表指向引用它的子表。成组字段共同构成同一条外键。
The arrow points from the parent table to the child that references it. Grouped columns form a single foreign key.
field.selectHelp: 选择字段调整生成器与参数。
Select a field to adjust its generator and parameters.
source.indirect: 结构上的间接上游；本次引用中间表已有数据，此关系不要求先生成该来源。
Indirect upstream dependency in the schema. This plan uses existing data in the intermediate table, so this source does not need to be generated first.
source.generatedKeys: 先生成父表，再从生成后的有效主键取值。
Generate the parent table first, then use its valid primary keys.
source.generated: 父表也在本次生成范围，按依赖顺序先生成。
The parent is also selected and will be generated first in dependency order.
source.existing: 已有 {rows} 行 · 仅引用，不新增。已检查存在可用引用值，因此无需勾选父表。
Existing rows: {rows} · Reference only, no new rows. Usable reference values were found, so the parent does not need to be selected.
source.nullable: 无可用引用值；此外键允许 NULL。
No usable reference values; this foreign key allows NULL.
source.empty: 无可用引用值；请将父表加入生成范围。
No usable reference values; add the parent table to the generation scope.
source.unchecked: {rows} · {scope}；是否有可用引用值以检查结果为准。
{rows} · {scope}; check the configuration to confirm usable reference values.
source.none: 当前表没有上游外键或关联依赖。
This table has no upstream foreign key or association dependencies.
source.noExternal: 所选表没有外部引用依赖。
Selected tables have no external reference dependencies.
source.upstreamHelp: 此处展示本表依赖的完整上游链。图中的下游表示受本表影响的表，不是本表的生成前置条件。
This shows the table's complete upstream chain. Downstream tables in the graph are affected by this table; they are not prerequisites for generating it.
source.detailsHelp: 查看来源字段映射、已有数据与生成范围之间的关系。
View field mappings and how existing source data relates to the generation scope.
dependency.selectedTitle: 检查所选表的规则与依赖
Check rules and dependencies for selected tables
dependency.excluded: 当前表未纳入本次检查范围。这里仅解释结构；加入生成后再检查规则与引用来源。
This table is outside the current check scope. Only its structure is explained here; add it to generation to check rules and reference sources.
dependency.notChecked: The current configuration has not been checked.
cycle.keepTitle: 只重建其他表，保留基础数据
Rebuild other tables and keep the base data
cycle.keepHelp: 如果现有基础数据可以保留，在左侧取消勾选：{tables}。这里包含循环表及其上游来源，保留它们及已有引用，再检查其余表的生成计划。

If you can keep the existing base data, deselect these tables on the left: {tables}. This includes the cycle and its upstream sources. Keep them and their existing references, then check the generation plan for the other tables.
cycle.keepSQLite: SQLite 可以继续核对其余表的清空计划；是否能够执行仍以新的规则与清空检查结果为准。
For SQLite, you can review a clearing plan for the other tables. Execution still requires the new rule and clearing checks to pass.
cycle.keepPostgres: PostgreSQL 在当前工作台仅支持追加，清空重建需要数据库工具或专用脚本。这里不会自动切换写入方式。
The workbench currently supports append only for PostgreSQL. Clearing and rebuilding requires database tooling or a dedicated script. The write mode will not be switched automatically.
cycle.keepCapabilities: 各写入方式仍受当前数据库能力与检查结果限制。
Each write mode remains subject to the database capabilities and check results.
cycle.keepLimit: 定位只帮助找到勾选项，不会自动修改范围。调整后重新检查规则和清空计划；必需的来源若为空，仍需先准备基础数据。
Locate only finds the selection control; it does not change the scope. After adjusting, recheck the rules and clearing plan. Empty required sources still need base data first.
cycle.locateScope: 定位需要调整的勾选项
cycle.rebuildTitle: 循环表也必须从零重建
Rebuild the cycle tables from scratch too
cycle.rebuildHelp: 当前工作台无法从空表重建这个循环。需要支持循环引用的数据库工具或专用脚本，按真实约束分阶段生成并补齐引用。SQLite 已有父键满足检查时可保留记录并追加；调整行数不能代替缺失的来源。

The workbench cannot rebuild this cycle from empty tables. Use tooling or a dedicated script that generates in phases and backfills references under the real constraints. SQLite append can retain existing records when parent-key checks pass; changing row counts cannot replace missing sources.
dependency.issues: 当前范围有待处理的问题。
This scope has issues to resolve.
dependency.passed: 引用来源与规则检查通过。
Reference sources and rules passed validation.
dependency.otherIssues: 整个计划仍有待处理项，请查看完整检查。
Other issues remain in the overall plan. View the full check.
config.title: 生成配置
Generation configuration
dependency.tableOrder: Generation order related to this table
dependency.incompletePlan: 尚未形成可执行计划；以下分组可能不包含循环依赖中的表。请先处理阻断项，再重新检查。
There is no executable plan yet. The groups below may omit tables in dependency cycles. Resolve blockers, then check again.
dependency.tableOrderHelp: 仅列本表及上游中已勾选的表；其他表在整个计划中查看。未勾选的来源使用已有数据。
Only this table and its selected upstream tables are listed. View the full plan for other tables. Unselected sources use existing data.
dependency.groupHelp: 同组表示没有先后依赖；执行仍逐表进行。
Tables in the same group have no ordering dependency. They are still processed one at a time.
scope.noneHelp: 请在左侧勾选至少一张要生成数据的表，再检查规则与依赖。
Select at least one table on the left, then check its rules and dependencies.
dependency.fullTitle: 整个计划 · 依赖检查
preview.issues: 样例有待处理项，请查看字段说明或依赖检查。
Some samples need attention. View field notes or the dependency check.
preview.partial: 仅更新可预览的部分样例；完整关联样例需等待父表有可用记录。
Only available samples were updated. Complete related samples require usable records in the parent tables.
preview.updated: {scope} samples updated. Nothing was written to the database.
defaults.engineBroken: {engine} 已安装但加载异常，暂不能应用。
{engine} is installed but could not load. It cannot be applied yet.
defaults.mimesisMissing: 当前环境未安装 Mimesis，暂不能应用。
Mimesis is not installed in this environment and cannot be applied yet.
defaults.engineMissing: 当前 Web 服务未提供此引擎，请检查安装环境。
This engine is unavailable in the current Web service. Check the installation environment.
defaults.repairHelp: 请在插件与版本中查看异常信息，处理后返回。
View the error in Components and versions, resolve it, then return.
defaults.installHelp: 在插件与版本中安装后，返回选择此引擎。
Install it in Components and versions, then return to select this engine.
defaults.applyHelp: 应用于当前配置中的所有表；已有表级、字段级覆盖保留，检查时会提示不兼容的引擎设置。
Applies to all tables in the current configuration. Existing table and field overrides are kept; validation reports incompatible engine settings.
defaults.localeHelp: 影响生成内容的语言与格式，不改变界面语言。
Affects the language and format of generated content, not the interface language.
preview.loading: 正在生成样例，不写入数据库…
Generating samples without writing to the database…
dependency.loading: 正在检查结构、规则与依赖…
dependency.stale: 配置已变化，旧的检查结果已丢弃，请重新检查。
Configuration changed. The old check result was discarded; check again.
preview.refreshed: 样例已更新；数据库未写入。
Samples updated; nothing was written to the database.
dependency.appendValid: 追加生成的依赖与规则检查通过。
Append dependencies and rules passed validation.
dependency.foundIssues: 发现 {count} 个待处理项，请查看依赖检查。
Issues found: {count}. View the dependency check.
schema.changed: 数据库结构已变化，请检查保留的规则后重新保存。
Database schema changed. Review the retained rules and save again.
schema.refreshed: 已重新读取结构与行数。
config.openHelp: 仅列出当前数据库的配置。打开前会保存当前未保存的修改。
Only configurations for this database are listed. Unsaved changes will be saved before another configuration is opened.
yaml.label: YAML 或 JSON 配置
YAML or JSON configuration
yaml.help: 默认使用 YAML，也可读取或粘贴 JSON。应用后更新生成配置；写入数据库仍需单独确认。
YAML is the default; you can also load or paste JSON. Applying updates the generation configuration. Writing to the database still requires separate confirmation.
yaml.tooLarge: 配置文件不得超过 2 MiB
Configuration files must not exceed 2 MiB
yaml.changed: 文本已变化，请重新应用或下载当前内容。
The text changed. Apply again or download the current content.
yaml.applied: 配置已应用，请检查并保存。
Configuration applied. Check and save it.
yaml.credentials: 导出内容省略连接凭据，单独执行时需补充连接信息。
Exported content omits connection credentials. Add connection details before running it independently.
yaml.failed: 配置文档未能读取，请关闭后重试。
Unable to read the configuration document. Close this dialog and try again.
graph.title: 数据库关系图
Database relationship graph
graph.placeholder: 粘贴关系图 JSON，或选择文件
Paste relationship graph JSON or select a file
graph.tooLarge: 关系图文件不得超过 1 MiB
Graph files must not exceed 1 MiB
graph.importHelp: 导入后只读浏览表与外键关系，不会创建或修改数据库。生成配置继续绑定当前数据库。
Importing only displays tables and foreign keys. It does not create or modify a database. The generation configuration stays bound to the current database.
graph.formatDetails: nodes 是表列表；edges 中 source 为父表、target 为子表，sourceColumns 和 targetColumns 按位置一一对应。复合外键放在同一条边内。
nodes lists tables. In edges, source is the parent and target is the child. sourceColumns and targetColumns correspond by position. Keep composite foreign keys in a single edge.
graph.invalidFormat: 不支持此关系图格式或版本，请参考格式模板。
Unsupported graph format or version. Refer to the format template.
graph.invalidSize: 需要 nodes 和 edges，支持 1—200 张表 / 最多 1000 条关系。
nodes and edges are required. Supported size: 1–200 tables and up to 1,000 relationships.
graph.invalidNodes: 每张表需要非空且唯一的 id。
Each table must have a nonempty, unique id.
graph.invalidEndpoints: 关系的 source / target 必须对应 nodes 中的表 id。
Each edge's source and target must match table IDs in nodes.
graph.invalidColumns: 外键列必须是长度相同的字符串数组。
Foreign key columns must be string arrays of equal length.
graph.invalidIds: 每条关系需要唯一的 id。
Each relationship needs a unique id.
graph.readOnly: 只读关系图 · 与当前生成配置分开浏览
Read-only graph · Viewed separately from the current generation configuration
clear.expandHelp: 要清空后重新生成，还需将 {count} 张关联表纳入重建范围。先核对完整范围，再继续清空计划。

clear.expandHelp.one: To clear and regenerate, include {count} related table in the rebuild scope. Review the full scope before continuing to the clear plan.
clear.expandHelp.other: To clear and regenerate, include {count} related tables in the rebuild scope. Review the full scope before continuing to the clear plan.

clear.resolveHelp: 要继续清空重建，请先处理下列问题。
Resolve the issues below to continue clearing and rebuilding.
clear.scopeChanged: 重建范围已调整，请重新检查清空计划。
Rebuild scope adjusted. Recheck the clear plan.
clear.expand: Include related tables and continue rebuilding
clear.relatedTables: 需一并重建的关联表（点击可定位）：
Related tables to rebuild together (select to locate):
clear.previousTables: 上次检查涉及的关联表：
Related tables from the previous check:
clear.retryHelp: {error} 请重新检查；尚未写入数据库。
{error} Check again; nothing has been written to the database.
clear.switchAppend: 改为追加，保留现有数据
Switch to append and keep existing data
clear.expandTitle: Complete the clear and rebuild scope
clear.confirmScope: 确认范围，查看清空计划
Confirm scope and view clear plan
clear.scopeCounts: {original} 张 → {total} 张：新增 {added} 张表
clear.relatedHelp: 以下关联表需要一并清空，再按各自规则重新生成。已自动查找所有受影响的下游表。
These related tables must also be cleared and regenerated using their own rules. All affected downstream tables have been located automatically.
clear.confirmHelp: 确认范围后会保存配置并打开清空计划；只有在下一步确认“清空并生成”后才会写入数据库。
Confirming the scope saves the configuration and opens the clear plan. Data is only written after you confirm Clear and generate in the next step.
clear.countDisclaimer: 现有行数仅供审阅参考，最终清空数量以重新获取的生成计划为准。规则检查通过仍不代表清空一定可行，触发器、自引用等还需清空预检。

Existing row counts are for review only; the refreshed generation plan determines the final clear counts. Passing rule validation does not guarantee clearing is possible. Triggers, self-references and other conditions require a clear preflight check.
clear.unresolved: 无法定位关联表 {tables}，请重新读取数据库结构后核对。
Cannot locate related tables: {tables}. Refresh the database schema and review the scope.
clear.noCandidates: 没有可自动补入的关联表，请调整重建范围。
No related tables can be added automatically. Adjust the rebuild scope.
clear.checkingCandidate: 正在检查候选范围的规则与依赖，不修改当前配置…
Checking rules and dependencies for the candidate scope without changing the current configuration…
clear.candidatePassed: 规则检查通过。核对下方新增表后，可直接继续清空计划。
Rules passed validation. Review the added tables below, then continue to the clear plan.
clear.candidateFailed: 这个范围仍有生成规则问题，暂时不能继续清空重建。请先调整下列冲突表。
This scope still has rule issues and cannot be rebuilt yet. Adjust the conflicting tables below.
clear.candidateError: 候选范围检查未完成：{error}。当前配置未改变，请稍后重新检查。
Candidate scope check did not complete: {error}. The current configuration is unchanged. Try again later.
execution.title: 确认生成数据
Confirm data generation
execution.fileTargetHelp: 当前连接的数据库位置；由运行 Web 的设备访问。
Location of the connected database, accessed by the device running the Web service.
execution.urlTargetHelp: 当前连接的数据库地址；连接凭据已隐藏。
Address of the connected database. Connection credentials are hidden.
execution.appendHelp: 保留已有记录，由数据库继续分配 ID。
Keep existing records and let the database continue assigning IDs.
execution.replaceHelp: 删除下列所选表的现有记录，再生成新数据。
Delete existing records in the selected tables below, then generate new data.
execution.postgresAppend: PostgreSQL 暂未开放清空模式；当前仅支持追加数据。
Clear mode is not available for PostgreSQL yet. Only appending is supported.
execution.resetHelp: 仅清空后可选。SQLite AUTOINCREMENT 从 1 重新分配；普通整数主键在空表中通常也从 1 开始。
Available only in clear mode. SQLite AUTOINCREMENT restarts at 1; ordinary integer primary keys also usually start at 1 in an empty table.
execution.appendUnchecked: 追加生成的依赖与规则尚未通过检查。
Append dependencies and rules have not passed validation yet.
execution.appendPlanHelp: 追加生成的依赖与规则检查已通过。向现有数据追加，不清空表；自动主键由数据库继续分配。按此顺序逐表写入。若中途失败，后续表停止；已经提交的数据保留，实际数量可在运行记录中查看。

Append dependencies and rules passed validation. New data is added without clearing tables; the database assigns automatic primary keys. Tables are written in this order. If a table fails, later tables stop and committed data is retained. View actual counts in Runs.
execution.preflight: 正在核对清空范围、外键与事务能力…
Checking clear scope, foreign keys and transaction support…
execution.atomic: 清空与本次生成在同一事务中完成。失败将回滚本次操作，保留原有数据。
Clearing and generation run in one transaction. Failure rolls back this operation and preserves the original data.
execution.nonAtomic: 此模式不具备整体回滚能力。
This mode does not support a full rollback.
